name: Twister Block
steps: Floorboards: Tap planks → align against door frame.
Cellar Hatch: Drag trapdoor → cover cellar entrance.
Dining Table: Drag table → wedge against door.
Iron Gate Screen: Drag metal gate → reinforce barrier.
Wall Painting: Tap painting → block wall crack.
Stepladder: Place ladder → brace upper frame.
Wardrobe Closet: Drag wardrobe → block center area.
Wood Clamps: Use clamps → secure all structures.
